# Scenario: Global Synchronized Recession

## Trigger
- G3 (US, EU, China) PMI all below 45
- Yield curve deeply inverted (> 12 months)
- Credit spreads blowing out (BBB spreads > 300bp)
- Central banks forced into aggressive cutting cycle

## Transmission Channels

### Rate Channel (Dominant)
- Aggressive rate cuts globally
- Bonds rally (duration — long end benefits most)
- Growth stocks initially sell off, then recover on rate cuts
- Banks: Margin compression, loan loss provisions surge

### FX Channel
- USD strengthens initially (flight to safety)
- EM FX sells off sharply
- JPY strengthens (carry trade unwind)
- Commodity currencies collapse

### Commodity Channel
- Demand collapse across energy, metals, agriculture
- Oil crashes (demand elasticity)
- Gold rallies (real rates falling, safe haven)
- Industrial metals: severe demand destruction

### Liquidity Channel
- Flight to quality: Cash, government bonds, gold
- Credit markets freeze — liquidity premium spikes
- Central banks restart QE / emergency facilities

## Sector Impact Matrix

| Sector | Trough Impact | Recovery Pattern |
|--------|-------------|-----------------|
| Tech | 🔴 -25 to -35% | Leads recovery (rate sensitive) |
| Banks | 🔴 -30 to -40% | Lags (credit losses) |
| Energy | 🔴 -30 to -50% | Lags (demand recovery slow) |
| REITs | 🔴 -25 to -35% | Leads (rate sensitive) |
| Staples | 🟢 -5 to -10% | Holds up best |
| Healthcare | 🟢 -5 to -15% | Defensive |
| Gold Miners | 🟢 +10 to +30% | Safe haven bid |
| Crypto | 🔴 -40 to -60% | Liquidity collapse |

## Playbook
1. **Pre-recession**: Reduce cyclical, add duration (long bonds), build cash
2. **Early recession**: Defensive rotation (staples, healthcare, utilities), gold
3. **Mid recession**: Start scaling into quality cyclicals, extend bond duration
4. **Late recession / Recovery**: Aggressive risk-on (small caps, cyclicals, EM)

## Key Monitoring Triggers
- [ ] US ISM Manufacturing < 45
- [ ] Global PMI composite < 48
- [ ] Initial claims > 300K and rising
- [ ] HY OAS > 500bp
- [ ] Fed emergency cut or inter-meeting cut
- [ ] Sahm Rule triggered (> 0.50pp)
